Company aur Brand ka Parichay
Q1. Propnex AI Technology kya hai?
Jawab: Propnex AI Technology practical AI solutions banati hai, jaise voice agents aur business
process automation. Hum businesses ki madad karte hain taaki unka baar-baar hone wala kaam kam
ho aur customers ko behtar service mil sake.
Q2. Propnex AI Technology ka maksad kya hai?
Jawab: Hamara maksad hai ki kaam aane wala AI alag-alag size ke businesses tak aasaani se
pahunche. Hum aise solutions par focus karte hain jo time bachayein, team ko support dein aur
customer experience ko smooth banayein.

hai ki AI ko business ki asli problems solve karne ke liye use kiya jaye.

Jawab: Idea yeh tha ki practical AI ke mauke ko aise products mein badla jaye jo businesses ke sach
mein kaam aayein. Hamara focus asli workflow problems solve karne par hai, bina maksad ke
technology jodne par nahi.
Q5. Propnex AI Technology doosron se alag kaise hai?
Jawab: Hum pehle customer ka workflow samajhte hain aur dekhte hain ki automation kahan sabse
zyada fark la sakti hai. Hamara solution aapke business, aapke maujooda tools aur aapke customers
ke hisaab se banta hai.

Jawab: Hum startups, chhote aur medium businesses, aur bade organisations ke saath projects

requirements par depend karti hai.

Jawab: Nahi, voice agent ek option hai. Hum document processing, workflow automation, data
handling aur customer operations mein bhi madad kar sakte hain. Pehle hum aapka use case
samajhte hain, phir sahi approach suggest karte hain.

Q9. Main Propnex AI Technology se kaise contact kar sakta hoon?
Jawab: Aap company ke official contact channels ke zariye Propnex team se baat kar sakte hain.
Bas apni business problem aur pasand ka contact method bata dijiye, taaki sahi insaan aapse follow
up kar sake.

Q11. Voice agent mere business ki kaise madad karega?
Jawab: Voice agent aam sawaalon aur support calls ko office hours ke baad bhi sambhal sakta hai.
Yeh zaroori jaankari ek jagah collect kar sakta hai aur mushkil requests ko team ke kisi insaan ko de
sakta hai.
Voice Agent ki Basic Jaankari
Q12. Kya voice agent humare products pitch kar sakta hai?
Jawab: Haan, voice agent approved product information samjha sakta hai, discovery questions
pooch sakta hai aur agla sahi step suggest kar sakta hai. Uski script sahi honi chahiye aur usme aise
wade nahi hone chahiye jo business ne authorise nahi kiye.
Q13. Kya AI agent outbound calls kar sakta hai?
Jawab: Haan, jahan use case, platform aur local rules allow karte hain, wahan outbound call

nahi kiye.
Q13. Kya AI agent outbound calls kar sakta hai?
Jawab: Haan, jahan use case, platform aur local rules allow karte hain, wahan outbound calling ho
sakti hai. Customer ki consent, caller ki pehchaan, opt-out ka option aur calling ka sahi time pehle se
process mein hona chahiye.
Q14. Kya yeh incoming customer calls le sakta hai?
Jawab: Haan, inbound agent aam sawaalon ke jawab de sakta hai aur caller ki zaroorat ke hisaab se
request aage route kar sakta hai. Sensitive ya alag tarah ke cases mein use kisi trained insaan ko
transfer karna chahiye.
Q15. Kya voice agent naturally bol sakta hai?
Jawab: Yeh speech model, voice, script, latency aur conversation design par depend karta hai. Asli
examples ke saath testing karne se team pronunciation, speed aur baat karne ki baari (turn-taki

ncy aur conversation design par depend karta hai. Asli
examples ke saath testing karne se team pronunciation, speed aur baat karne ki baari (turn-taking)
ko behtar bana sakti hai.
Q16. Kya voice agent alag-alag accents samajh sakta hai?
Jawab: Yeh speech recognition model aur testing mein shamil accents par depend karta hai. Hum
suggest karte hain ki system ko usi language, accent aur call conditions mein test karein jo aapke
customers asal mein use karte hain.
Q17. Kya agent call kisi insaan ko transfer kar sakta hai?
Jawab: Haan, achhe se design kiya gaya agent tab call transfer kar sakta hai jab caller maange ya
issue uske scope se bahar ho. Transfer ke waqt zaroori context saath jaana chahiye, taaki customer
ko sab kuch dobara na batana pade.

Q18. Kya voice agent 24/7 kaam kar sakta hai?
Jawab: Haan, deployed system ko din-raat calls lene ke liye design kiya ja sakta hai, service
availability aur operating limits ke andar. Jab system kisi request ko solve na kar paye, tab escalation
path aur clear fallback message hona zaroori hai.
Product Pitch aur Lead Qualification
Q19. Agent hamare product ka introduction kaise dega?
Jawab: Woh ek chhote aur transparent introduction se shuru karega aur pooch lega ki customer ke
paas baat karne ka time hai ya nahi. Phir woh product ki relevant value saral bhasha mein
samjhayega aur sawaal poochne ke liye invite karega.

Q20. Agent sales lead ko qualify kaise karta hai?
Jawab: Woh prospect ki zaroorat, abhi ka process, timeline, approximate requirements aur follow-up
ka preferred tareeka poochta hai. Agar integration aur permissions hain, toh yeh jaankari CRM mein
record ho sakti hai.
Q21. Kya agent sales meeting book kar sakta hai?
Jawab: Haan, woh preferred date aur time le sakta hai aur approved calendar integration ho toh
availability check kar sakta hai. Confirm karne se pehle woh details verify karega aur authorised
channel se promised confirmation bhejega.
Q22. Kya agent interested prospects ko follow up kar sakta hai?
Jawab: Haan, follow-up workflow aise prospects ko contact karne ke liye set kiya ja sakta hai jinhone
contact hone ki permissio

llow up kar sakta hai?
Jawab: Haan, follow-up workflow aise prospects ko contact karne ke liye set kiya ja sakta hai jinhone
contact hone ki permission di hai. Timing, frequency, consent aur opt-out preferences ka dhyan
rakhna zaroori hai.
Q23. Agent 'Mujhe interest nahi hai' ko kaise handle karega?
Jawab: Woh politely jawab accept karega aur person par koi pressure nahi daalega. Agar customer
kahe, toh woh opt-out record karega, taaki aage outreach band ho jaye.
Q24. Kya agent pricing samjha sakta hai?
Jawab: Agent wahi pricing, packages aur conditions bata sakta hai jo business ne approve ki hain.
Agar pricing scope par depend karti hai ya confirm nahi hai, toh woh sales team ke saath discussion
arrange karne ki offer dega.

Q25. Kya agent humare product ki competitor se tulna kar sakta hai?
Jawab: Woh approved aur current information ke basis par verified differences bata sakta hai. Usko
aise claims nahi karne chahiye jinka saboot na ho, aur competitor ke baare mein koi unfair ya
unverified baat nahi kehni chahiye.
Q26. Kya agent prospects ki objections handle kar sakta hai?
Jawab: Haan, woh aam concerns ka short aur factual jawab de sakta hai aur kaam ke sawaal pooch
sakta hai. Complex commercial, legal ya technical objections ke liye woh human follow-up offer
karega.
Q27. Kya agent call ke baad brochure bhej sakta hai?
Jawab: Agar messaging ya email integration configure hai aur customer agree karta hai, toh agent
approved

approved brochure bhejne ka trigger de sakta hai. Woh pehle destination confirm karega aur jab tak
system confirm na kare, tab tak yeh nahi kahega ki file bhej di gayi.
Automation aur Workflows
Q28. Business process automation kya hota hai?
Jawab: Business process automation mein software ek workflow ke baar-baar hone wale steps khud
perform karta hai. Isse manual data entry kam hoti hai, routine kaam standard hote hain aur teams
kaam ko behtar track kar paati hain.
Q29. Kaun se kaam automation ke liye achhe candidates hain?
Jawab: Jin kaamon mein clear rules, repeated steps, structured information aur measurable results
hote hain, woh aksar achhe ca

achhe candidates hain?
Jawab: Jin kaamon mein clear rules, repeated steps, structured information aur measurable results
hote hain, woh aksar achhe candidates hote hain. Jaise requests ko route karna, records update
karna, routine reports banana aur status notifications bhejna.

Q30. Kya Propnex repetitive office work automate karne mein madad kar sakti hai?
Jawab: Haan, hum repetitive workflows ko assess karte hain aur AI ya software automation ke
possible mauke dhundhte hain. Final design involved systems, data quality, permissions aur business
requirements par depend karta hai.
Q31. Kya automation alag-alag software systems ko connect kar sakti hai?
Jawab: Haan, integrations APIs, approved connectors ya doosre supported methods se systems ko
connect kar sakte hain. Implementation se pehle team data access, security, reliability aur vendor
limitations check karti hai.
Q32. Workflow kya hota hai?

Q32. Workflow kya hota hai?
Jawab: Workflow un steps ka sequence hota hai jo kisi kaam ko shuru se poora hone tak le jaata hai.
Automation steps trigger kar sakti hai, conditions check kar sakti hai, kaam assign kar sakti hai aur
zaroorat par logon ko notify kar sakti hai.
Q33. Kya automation se human errors kam hote hain?
Jawab: Jab rules aur source data sahi hon, tab automation kuch repetitive entry aur handoff errors
kam kar sakti hai. Phir bhi monitoring, exception handling aur time-time par checks zaroori hain, taaki
galat input ya anokhe cases pakde ja sakein.
Q34. Kya automated tasks ke liye human approval chahiye hoti hai?
Jawab: Haan, important steps ko poora hone se pehle human review ke liye rok sakte hain. Yeh
payments, sensitive communication, compliance decisions aur

payments, sensitive communication, compliance decisions aur aise changes ke liye khaas taur par
kaam ka hai jinhe palatna mushkil ho.
Q35. Agar koi automated task fail ho jaye toh kya hota hai?
Jawab: Ek reliable workflow error ko record karta hai, jahan sahi ho wahan safely retry karta hai aur
zimmedar insaan ko alert bhejta hai. Woh duplicate actions se bachta hai aur manual recovery ka
clear raasta bhi deta hai.

Jawab: Haan, agar zaroori data accessible ho aur report ka format tay ho. Automated reports mein
reporting period, data source aur limitations dikhne chahiye, taaki users unhe sahi samajh sakein.

Jawab: Haan, agar integration un actions ko support karta hai aur permissions mile hain, toh
connected agent CRM records bana ya update kar sakta hai. Validation rules se incomplete,

Q38. Kya yeh customer calls ka summary bana sakta hai?
Jawab: Suitable speech processing aur consent ke saath system summary, key needs, action items

Q40. Kya yeh aam sawaalon (FAQs) ke jawab de sakta hai?
Jawab: Haan, support agent approved knowledge sources se aam sawaalon ke jawab de sakta hai.
Jab jawab missing, purana ya bahut sensitive ho, tab woh apni uncertainty bataye aur call kisi insaan
ko de.
Q41. Kya yeh support tickets bana sakta hai?
Jawab: Agar ticketing platform se connected hai, toh agent issue ki details lekar sahi category aur
priority ke saath ticket bana sakta hai. Customer ko reference number tabhi dena chahiye jab ticket
creation confirm ho jaye.

record kar sakta hai. Feedback dena voluntary hona chahiye aur customer ke paas baat khatam
karne ka aasaan tareeka hona chahiye.
Q44. Kya yeh sales logon ko follow-up ki yaad dila sakta hai?
Jawab: Haan, automation agreed CRM events, deadlines ya customer preferences ke basis par
reminders bana sakti hai. Reminders sahi owner tak jaane chahiye aur unnecessary duplicate
notifications nahi hone chahiye.

Jawab: Urgency ka andaaza keywords, customer ke choices aur pehle se tay business rules se
lagaya ja sakta hai. Critical cases ke liye escalation criteria clear hone chahiye, kyunki automated
classification kabhi galat bhi ho sakti hai.
Real Estate aur Construction
Q46. AI real estate company ki kaise madad karta hai?
Jawab: AI lead qualification, property enquiries, appointment scheduling, document workflows aur

property data par depend karta hai.
